name: @wellsfargo-starui/star-demo
description: Minimal OpenFin workspace demo hosting MarketsGrid via routes, registrable as a workspace component. Cloned from markets-ui-react-reference with the boilerplate stripped and Import/Export Config removed from the dock Tools menu.
//dependencies-registry-notes: react-grid-layout pinned to the ^2.2.x stable line. 2.x is the React-19-safe major: 1.x reached react-draggable/react-resizable through the removed ReactDOM.findDOMNode, while 2.2.4 passes nodeRef throughout (verified rendering under react 19.2 with zero console errors). It also replaces the WidthProvider HOC with the useContainerWidth hook, so there is no HOC to fight StrictMode. Chosen over gridstack (framework-agnostic and imperative — it owns the DOM nodes React is meant to own, and is 2.07MB unpacked to RGL's 448KB) and over react-mosaic (binary-tree tiling, no free 2D placement). @types are bundled; do not add @types/react-grid-layout, which only describes 1.x.
